messages:
anna: quick question — should we surface routing+quota hints inline on the per-route saved query card? users keep asking why a saved view uses a fallback model, and it feels like a discoverability problem.
ryan: yes, we've seen support tickets asking why a route suddenly switches to a cheaper model. inline hint could reduce confusion.
sophia: agree, but we need to be careful about noise. maybe show hint collapsed unless user expands? small :info: icon with hover text?
mike: technically we can expose the routing decision metadata on the saved-query API: route_id, model_variant, routing_policy, quota_bucket. frontend can decide what to show.
anna: perfect — can you propose an API shape? minimal so we don't create coupling. UX wants label like: "routing: <policy> (active model: <model-name>)" and a link to explain fallback.
mike: draft shape:

```
"routing": {
  "policy": "latency_first",
  "resolved_model": "redwood/gpt-2-8k-q4",
  "fallback_reason": "no_dedicated_capacity",
  "quota_key": "team-123/route-456"
}
```

we can omit resolved_model if not populated.
ryan: fallback_reason is handy. also include a boolean `is_forced_fallback`? sometimes customers pin a fallback variant.
sophia: front-end note — prefer short enum keys. UI wants a concise primary line + optional expanded section with more telemetry links (e.g., last 7d percent routed to fallback).
anna: telemetry link is good. we should surface a small sample metric: "% fallback (7d)" so PMs get quick signal.
mike: backend can compute percent_fallback_7d as a number and include `fallback_rate_7d: 0.12`. cost concern — computing this on read might be heavy. can add to async batch job and store on route metadata.
ryan: alternative: include only a pointer (telemetry_url) and let console fetch metrics lazily. keeps saved-query payload tiny.
sophia: lazy fetch recommended. initial card shows: policy + resolved model + an "i" icon. expand panel fetches metrics + last resolved timestamp + link to rollout history.
anna: rollout history link is key — folks want to see when model pins changed. can we reuse existing rollout API?
mike: yes, rollout history lives in /api/v1/rollouts?route_id=... we'll return a short permalink. add to shape as `rollout_link`.
anna: acceptance criteria for this ticket:
1) saved-query card shows routing policy and resolved model (if any) with i-hover text
2) expand loads fallback_rate_7d and last_resolved_ts + rollout_link
3) small copy and help page linked explaining routing layers and quota buckets
4) lazy metrics fetch to avoid payload bloat

ryan: dev question — do we gate on a flag for enterprise only? some fields expose quota bucket identifiers that might be sensitive.
sophia: we can hide quota_key in UI unless viewer has elevated permissions. show humanized text instead.
mike: on the API side we'll include quota_key only when token has scope `routes:insights`. otherwise return `quota_key: null`.
anna: perfect. rollout plan: canary to 10% of orgs for 2 weeks and collect support tickets + clickthrough on help link.
ryan: ops-bot FYI — can we get an alert if fallback_rate_7d > 0.5 for any route after rollout?
ops-bot: deploy scheduled. I'll add a metric alert: alert if fallback_rate_7d computed > 0.5 for any public route OR > 0.8 for private routes. :bell:
mike: I'll add the telemetry_url and rollout_link fields to the saved-query indexer job. putting a short PR up today.
sophia: I'll wire up the UI hover copy and expand behavior. will stub telemetry fetch with `telemetry_url` + show loading skeleton.
anna: timeline: API PR this week, console patch next week, canary rollout 2 weeks after merge. Thanks everyone! :tada:
ryan: one last edge: what if resolved_model is a variant that doesn't support some console features (e.g., embeddings)? add `capabilities` list?
mike: good point. add optional `capabilities: ["generations","embeddings"]` — string list, optional.
sophia: UI will show an icon set if embeddings not supported to warn users when they try embedding-specific filters.
anna: awesome. I'll open the ticket with the shape and acceptance criteria. end.
